steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Rainforest's same as ever, huh.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's been a really long time, hasn't it, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Never liked this place. Air's stifling, and the ground gives too easy. Can't place a single firm step.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: A lot of tribes have moved into the rainforest, though.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That so? ...Hey, Doctor, looks like you're up. How'd you sleep last night?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You adapt fast, huh, Doctor? Hell, I thought you wouldn't be able to stand roughing it out here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha. Your eyes say it all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, I'd believe you if you weren't trying to rub your temples.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Didn't I tell you, Doctor? Gotta be ready. It's not about to get any easier.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Here. Scrounged up what I could find nearby to make some soup. Go on, it'll wake you up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, speaking of which. Never realized it until I went looking, but actually, there's a hell of a lot of medicinal plants that grow around this rainforest.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Gavial's actually taking care of people...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: G... Gavial, I didn't sleep good either...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? And you call yourself an Archosauria?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Archosauria... *wail* Gavial doesn't remember our original name...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm? Oh, crap, I did forget. I mean Tiacauh, don't I.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Damn, I don't think I've used that word at all since I left. Doctor, you make a note to yourself. We don't divvy ourselves up by race here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I mean, from that perspective, uh, lemme think... I'm an Archosauria, Zumama's a Phidia, and there's also Liberi... yeah, that's your three, more or less.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But we all count ourselves as Tiacauh. Means 'one valiant in war' in our language.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Also, not that I think you're gonna need it, but you might like to know we call this place Acahualla. 'Land where the forest overgrows.'

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Alright, enough bawling your eyes out. Get your people in gear and let's move.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Whimper)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Rhodes Island. Doctor...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, yeah, right. So, a company is...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah, I know that! Since you left, Gavial, I've been learning about the outside world!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh yeah? That adds up. You dress different from how you used to, too, now that I think about it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep! This is really fashionable on the outside!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I don't really get fashion. Is she right, Doctor?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, so the Doctor's seen it too!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, your friend doesn't seem like a fashion expert either.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha. There's something even you don't know, huh.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, yeah, Tomimi, how about you introduce the Doctor to our place? I've been away for forever. I don't know what's changed.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay, let me think. What should I tell an outsider...? Right, let's start with the tribes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Look at this map. Here's where Gavial landed, and here's the path we took.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: This big forested area is our Acahualla.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Traditionally, every tribe of Acahualla, big and small, joins in this ceremony where we choose the next Great Chief.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, and the ceremony a trial by combat. Whoever beats all the other challengers and earns their recognition gets the right to challenge the current Great Chief.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: If they defeat the Great Chief, they become the new one.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Now the power of the Great Chief? Every tribe listens to what she says, for starters!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sounds like nothing's really changed, then.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Something has!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: One day, the last Great Chieftain Juan drank too much and his wife chased him to the edge of a cliffside. He jumped off it and never came back. Our last ceremony was to pick his successor.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But some stuff happened with Gavial and we never chose a Great Chief. And ever since Gavial left, none of the tribes have really gotten along with each other.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So now we've all been stuck fighting each other.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wuh? That part's actually normal for us.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: My dad said Great Chief Juan was one of the longest Great Chiefs ever. We'd usually get a new one every two or three years.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Whenever we lose a Great Chief's, we do the ceremony to pick a new one.

options: Now what was that about Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What? Oh, yeah, I never told anybody at Rhodes Island about that stuff.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I beat every single comer to the whole damn thing and then I left.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. I was pissed. Went and knocked all their lights out.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Anyway, that's another story. Any especially strong tribes running around?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: A bunch of them are pretty powerful now.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: First is the one that Zumama leads, the Eunectes tribe.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: She settled her tribe in another part of the rainforest near a lot of ore veins. She has a hold on most of our metal resources.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: That tribe always liked making weird tools and weapon things. They've absorbed a lot of the small tribes that surrounded them.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Second is Kemar's Flint tribe.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The rainforest Tiacauh don't live quite the same as the rest of us. They're a lot more scattered. Normally, they don't even communicate with us.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But because we have no Great Chief, a lot of tribes ended up going into the rainforest.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Kemar's is one of them now.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: They were confident enough in their own power to take a piece of territory for themselves.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: There's one more tribe that's pretty notable. I think you recognize them too, Gavial. Inam's tribe.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Her tribe's called the 'Inam Committee.' The people in it act kind of weird. None of them really like fighting people, but they all like doing business.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: There are a lot of them too. Don't underestimate them.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I can picture it right now. Zumama setting her tribe up next to a mine. Yeah, ever since way back, she's loved making those weapons of hers or whatever.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Wouldn't have thought she'd be bossing a clan now, though. 'Eunectes' has a nice ring to it!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep. Zumama's Eunectes tribe is the strongest one too, now, and everyone thinks she's gonna be the next Chief.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not surprised. Kid's been pretty capable for a long while.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So, um, Gavial, are you really not gonna be the Great Chief?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nope. There's stuff on the outside I've gotta do.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Right, Doctor?

options: You can stay if you want.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Stuff on the outside, huh...?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Hmm. Is Gavial straightforward, or just cruel...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, there'll be a day when I come back here. But it's not today.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, you said you were gonna go for it in your letter, right? And you were confident, even?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, mm-hm!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I trained a lot for it!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Then I'm looking forward to the show!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Do I hear fighting?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Over that way. Let's go see.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Will you say it or not!?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Like I would!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Keh, you've got backbone.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, hey, they're fighting. Doctor, we can leave 'em. Let's just go. This happens all the time.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: You're done for, Thin-Tails. I'm gonna make you admit Thick-Tails are where it's at!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Yeah, in your dreams! Like I'd ever give in!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey! What's-your-face over there. What did you just say?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Who're you? Don't tell me you're a Thin-Tails too?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Like hell I am. But did I catch that right? You think thick tails are better?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: What? Obviously! Take a look at mine! Sturdy! Strong! Plump and plush! What's better than a nice thick tail like this, huh?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch. Whelp, can't pretend I didn't hear that shit!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Take a good look at my thin tail here. Slim, refined! Clean, distinct contours! Hell, I can actually grab things with it! Now this is a tail!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: I hear that! Thin tails for life! *Cough,* *cough!*

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Huh? You kidding? You can't even see a tail like that behind your ass!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, shout out to yours! I bet your ass loves when it can't sit down 'cause your tail's so fat!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah. Gavial's arguing with that one there about thin versus thick tails.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: It's a pretty common topic for us. You might say the tail is an Archosauria's greatest pride. People compare them. Whole tribes have even formed on how thick or thin their tails are.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I think the one fighting with Gavial might be a Thick-Tails.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Xolopitlipol! Brothers, come out!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Today's the day! We will make it known that thick tails reign supreme!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh. That's a lot of people. Um, Doctor, I'm going to help Gavial.
